content.short: Hong Kong's Animoca Brands invests in and builds web3 projects, with hundreds of portfolio companies from The Sandbox to Moca Network.
content.description: Animoca Brands is one of the most active investors in web3 games and consumer crypto. Its portfolio runs to several hundred projects, including well-known names in gaming and NFTs. Beyond investing, it builds its own products, such as The Sandbox and the Moca Network identity layer. It also helps portfolio teams with go-to-market work on Base, Polygon, ApeChain and other networks. Its work now spans three groups: institutions, through stablecoin, real-world asset and treasury services; consumers, through Moca Network, Open Campus, The Sandbox and Anichess; and founders, through digital asset advisory.
content.meta: Hong Kong web3 investor and builder behind The Sandbox, Moca Network and hundreds of portfolio projects. Explore Animoca Brands on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
